gen-gf-iansui-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly and personal, Iansui draws its diagonals as sturdy as its uprights, with gently flared ends that keep their distance. Bespoke Sans takes over below as a plain sans, sharp and refined, so paragraphs move along crisply with space around every curve.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-literata: Iansui looks hand-drawn and friendly, its thin joins no slimmer than its stems and its curve ends gently flared. But Literata, a classic serif with wide, unclosed curves, supplies the bookish polish that makes the handwriting feel grounded.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-bespoke-sans: Kavivanar writes with one relaxed, constant stroke and a friendly hand-drawn lilt. It's good at warmth, with curves that hold their weight at the shoulders, while Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, is good at sharp, refined clarity.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-literata: Literata reads like a bookish classic serif, its thin lines sturdy and its thicker strokes just a shade heavier, giving words a mild shimmer. Kavivanar is better at plain, unshaded, easygoing handwriting; Literata at quiet sophistication.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Klee One looks like casual pen-and-paper writing, with rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord. Its best quality is graceful friendliness, and Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with sharp, refined curves, gives that warmth a crisp counterweight.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-literata: Graceful Klee One has terminals cut short of the bowl, like neatly bent pipe cleaner. Literata follows in a bookish serif with a smooth, modest weight gradient, so a long page of text feels sophisticated and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-bespoke-sans: Lugrasimo's hand-drawn curves keep real weight even at their thinnest points, with a loose, spread-out line of text and no ink pooling at the turns. Make that heading small and the delicate looseness would fade next to Bespoke Sans.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, a plain sans with generous space between curve ends and the stem. Lumanosimo, by comparison, stretches casually across open gaps in wire-thick strokes, so a long passage would feel crisp below and loose above.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-literata: Loose, casual handwriting in wire-thick, rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, with a drawn-out feel across open gaps. Literata, a classic serif whose stems outweigh its hairlines just a little, gives that looseness a steady, bookish footing.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. Yet LXGW WenKai TC is the one that charms: a pen that never changes pressure, leaving open-handed curves and a gentle monotone of line thickness.
